queries.query: what is the annual leave policy
aliases: how many days of paid time off do employees get
queries.answer: According to the corporate leave policy, full-time employees are entitled to 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. All full-time employees are eligible upon standard employment confirmation.

queries.query: what is the salary of bob manager
aliases: how much does bob manager earn
queries.answer: According to the confidential Finance salary report, the entry salary of a Finance employee starts at $70,000, and Bob Manager earns $120,000.

queries.query: what is the executive bonus structure
queries.answer: Executive bonuses are capped at 50% of base salary. This compensation structure is restricted strictly to HR leadership and Executive administration.

queries.query: what are the engineering api architecture standards
queries.answer: TriGuard engineering API architecture requires deterministic RBAC token scoping, hardware-isolated microservice endpoints, and mutual TLS encryption across all enterprise data pipelines.
